title: SourceAdmissionRecord
description: Machine-checkable form of manual §18. Every admitted data source SHALL have exactly one of these. Field names and enum members are taken from the manual verbatim where the manual gives them.
$comment: TRACE: §18 field list; §18.1 project vs model exposure; §18.2 grouped splits; §6.28 ProjectHidden; §6.29 ModelExposureStatus; §6.25/§14.6 task mode; §6.30 ObservedTraceLength; §6.33 DependencyDepth. NOT EXPRESSIBLE IN JSON SCHEMA and therefore code-enforced: (a) that 'project_exposure_status' was true at the moment the confirmation role was frozen rather than asserted afterwards (§18.1 - previously inspected data is not project-hidden later merely because it is hashed or renamed); (b) that a source admitted_for PROMOTION or FINAL was not used to guide mutation, candidate selection, thresholds, or surrogate training (§30.4); (c) that 'grouping_unit' actually partitions the data (§18.2, §30.6). Violations of (a) or (b) are DEAD_LEAKAGE (§12.4); of (c), an invalid split. ADMISSION IS NOT SIZE-GATED: §18.3 - HC-V0 needs only enough verifier-backed material to prove the loop executes, and no minimum corpus size is required for the engineering smoke.

license_or_access_status.description: §18. Licence or access terms as stated by the source, e.g. 'CC BY 2.0'.

formal_backend.description: §18, §6.24. Which BackendKernelContract this source's truth is grounded in. Not a universal ontology (§13.3).

hashes.description: §18. Map from artifact path or logical name to sha256.

extraction_method.description: §18. How records were obtained from the source.

verification_method.description: §18. How each admitted record's truth was established, plus the §28 verifier declaration it relies on. A string comparison against a recorded transcript is NOT a verification method (§17.3).

project_exposure_status.description: §18.1, §6.28. SEPARATE from model_exposure_status. Concerns only whether Hamiltonian search/development inspected or used this data before its confirmation role was frozen.

value.$comment: PROJECT_HIDDEN is §6.28 verbatim. PROJECT_INSPECTED is its negation. UNKNOWN is §1's normative value and is not permission to guess. The three-member enum itself is an ENGINEERING_DECISION (§37); the manual names only the PROJECT_HIDDEN concept.

justification.description: §18.1. What makes the value true, and when the confirmation role was frozen. Hashing or renaming previously inspected data does not make it PROJECT_HIDDEN.

confirmation_role_frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, or null with UNKNOWN.

model_exposure_status.description: §6.29 verbatim. SEPARATE from project_exposure_status: project-hidden data may still be present in pretrained model data (§6.28, §18.1).

supported_task_mode.description: §18, §14.6. REPLAY does not demonstrate autonomous problem solving. A source admitted only as REPLAY blocks autonomous long-horizon claims (§18.4, §40.3).

observed_trace_distribution.description: §18, §6.30. Distribution of ObservedTraceLength. NOT a distribution of required reasoning horizon (§17.6).

dependency_depth_distribution_if_availab.description: §18, §6.33. Null when the task family defines no dependency depth measure; null is a recorded fact, not a defect.

grouping_unit.description: §18, §18.2, §30.6. The unit splits and clustered statistics use: theorem / module / repository / problem family. Random steps from the same proof family are NOT independent and MUST NOT be the grouping unit.

admitted_for.description: §18 verbatim. A source admitted_for PROMOTION or FINAL MUST NOT guide mutation, candidate selection, thresholds, or surrogate training (§30.4).

known_limitations.description: §18. Empty array means 'none recorded', which is a claim; it does not mean 'none exist' (§B.6 of spec/01_GLOSSARY.md).

sealed_splits_not_read.description: Splits present in the source tree that were deliberately not opened. Recording them is how §3.2's frozen-experiment boundary stays checkable.
